title: call() / subscribe_events() / upload_blob() / download_blob() accept unchecked URLs
description: The public methods call(api_url: &str), subscribe_events(event_source_url: &str), upload_blob(upload_url_template: &str), and download_blob(download_url_template: &str) accept any string. validate_session_urls() guards against bad URLs when the Session is fetched via fetch_session(), but these methods can also be called directly with any URL — extension crates or test harnesses could pass non-http schemes or file:// paths accidentally. The docstrings say 'pass URLs from the Session document' but do not enforce it. A first-call scheme check (the same http/https guard used in validate_session_urls) would make each method self-defending without adding significant complexity. reqwest will reject unknown schemes at send() time rather than at construction time, giving a confusing Http error instead of InvalidArgument.
